source_claim: CBSE Class XII SQP-derived candidates, not authentic CUET PYQs. Eight paper families total (2025-26 and 2026-27 x four subjects); candidates share paper/topic roots and English passage roots. They are not 64 independent question families.
limitations: A focused NCERT excerpt is not proof that every option or rationale is supported.
The 2026 syllabus is the latest locally bound official proxy; target-year 2027 entitlement is not verified.
English cases are answerable only from their exact adapted passages; no general NCERT fact source substitutes for a passage check.
Official CBSE marking schemes remain in custody only and are not present in this artifact or any blind-review context.
This audit deliberately does not classify an official key as truth; a source-backed independent key comparison is still required.
No construction item is removed from the denominator; unresolved cases remain quarantined, not graded as academic failures.

The four older-construction flags for Acc Q3 / English Q1-III are updated by v2 source-backed repairs and blind re-solves; neither item is certified correct until official-key custody reconciliation and claim-by-claim source audit.
Business Studies Q10 is quarantined after its single option adaptation failed the independent blind re-solve; no second repair was made.
